## Leg 2 re-run after PR #19595 landed — the two carriers stand, and a THIRD line now matches that is ⛔ NOT one, 2026-09-21T16:37Z

The card was filed while PR #19595 was still in the merge queue, so leg 2 was measured against a tree
where the repair had not landed. It has now: merge commit `5c5b67fc4140f76ca3158acea9e0845d9eebfad8`,
card #19407 closed `completed`. Re-run against the new `origin/main` `5c5b67fc41` — exit codes captured
**before** any pipe — because the card tells whoever takes it to re-run leg 2 first, and that instruction
is worth more if the answer is already on the record.

**The repair landed everywhere it said it would.** Probe for the three-filter form: exit **0**, **6**
lines — `package-api.zod.ts:202`, the ADR-0087 D3 semantic entry, the retired-key record comment, the
generated `registry.ts:13366` mirror, both rows of `package-api.mdx`, plus the TO side of the new
changeset's own before/after block.

**Probe for the two-filter enumeration** (`` `status` / `type` `` immediately followed by 「and then
returns」 / 「filters and returns」): exit **0**, **3** lines.

| line | verdict |
| --- | --- |
| `.changeset/17667-packages-query-contract.md:15` | ✅ **carrier** — this card's item 1, unchanged |
| `.changeset/scoped-packages-dispatcher-door.md:13` | ✅ **carrier** — this card's item 2, unchanged |
| `.changeset/19407-packages-list-tombstone-third-filter.md:23` | ⛔ **NOT a carrier** — it is the `FROM` side of PR #19595's own before/after block, with the corrected `TO` at `:27`. Quoting the old sentence to show what changed is the point of the block. **⛔ Do not "repair" it** — editing it would destroy the record of what moved |

⇒ the card's claim holds — **two carriers, both `.changeset/`** — but a naive re-run now returns three
lines, and the third is a deliberate quotation. Named here so it is not mistaken for a fourth defect or,
worse, silently "fixed".

⭐ **And the landing makes the deadline concrete rather than theoretical.** Both `17667-packages-query-contract.md`
(`'@objectstack/spec': minor`) and the just-landed `19407-packages-list-tombstone-third-filter.md`
publish into the **same** `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 changelog. Unrepaired, that published changelog
carries the stale sentence stated as current in one entry, immediately beside an entry whose whole
content is the correction of that sentence. That is the shape of the harm, and it is one release away.

## ⏱️⏱️ The deadline is not approaching — the release PR is OPEN, it is the 17.5.0 cut, and it ALREADY carries both stale sentences, 2026-09-21T16:54Z

The card said 「the cheapest moment to repair is before the cut」. Measured now: **the cut exists, as an open
PR, and both sentences are already written into its generated changelogs.** ⛔ Nothing below is adopted —
the release branch was fetched and read directly.

### ⏱️ Measured on `changeset-release/main` at `3b8ebe9a2dec9fa6fea7c3a131f4fa72fc005fec`

| reading | value |
| --- | --- |
| PR **#17076** `chore: version packages` | **open**, not draft, 720 files, `+47458/−20529` |
| `packages/spec/package.json` on that branch | **`17.5.0`** ⇒ this **is** the cut this card names |
| `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:1987` | 「… `status` / `type` and then returns every remaining row, so no page was ever …」 — **carrier 1, already published into the changelog** |
| `packages/runtime/CHANGELOG.md:654` | 「… this door applies its `status` / `type` filters and returns every remaining row …」 — **carrier 2, already published into the changelog** |
| ⭐ control — the **three**-filter form, same instrument, same two files | exit **1**, **0** lines ⇒ the corrected spelling is **nowhere** in the release changelogs |

⇒ the generated artefact that publishes these sentences is not hypothetical and is not scheduled. **It is
sitting in an open PR that anyone can merge.**

### What this changes, and what it does NOT

**It does not change the repair.** Still two one-line edits in `.changeset/`. The changesets bot regenerates
#17076 on every push to `main`, so repairing the two files on `main` **rewrites the release PR's changelog
entries before they publish** — ⛔ no edit to #17076 is needed and ⛔ none should be attempted.

**It does change the window.** The card's 「before the cut」 read as a future event with slack in it. The
honest reading: the window closes **whenever a human merges #17076**, which can be at any moment and
depends on nobody's schedule. There is no later cheap moment — after that merge the text is in a released
`CHANGELOG.md` and only a dedicated docs-only PR against a published entry can touch it.

### ⓘ One reading that is NOT a defect, so nobody chases it

PR #17076's head is from 2026-09-21T12:21:19Z and the repair (PR #19595) landed at
2026-09-21T16:36:28Z, so the release branch **predates** the repair. That is why the three-filter
control reads 0 there: ⛔ not a failed repair, just a release PR that has not regenerated since. It will
pick the repair up on the next push to `main` — the same mechanism this card depends on.

⇒ ⚠️ and that is precisely the point: **the same regeneration that will carry #19595's fix into the release
will carry these two stale sentences into it too, unless they are repaired first.**

### ⛔ This seat is routing its own filed card, and says so rather than letting it pass unnoticed

This card was filed by this seat today, **unlabelled**, with 「routing and grading are triage's」 on its face. Claiming it now routes it without waiting for triage. ⛔ That is a departure and it is deliberate: the release PR that consumes these two changesets is **open right now**, and after it merges the repair is only possible as a docs-only PR against a published `CHANGELOG.md`. ⛔ The **grading** is still triage's — this claim adds `pm:dispatched` and takes no `priority:*`.

### Premise re-verified at head `5c5b67fc41`, and ⛔ the first probe was WRONG

| leg | reading |
| --- | --- |
| `.changeset/17667-packages-query-contract.md` | two-filter enumeration **PRESENT**, three-filter **absent** |
| `.changeset/scoped-packages-dispatcher-door.md` | two-filter enumeration **PRESENT**, three-filter **absent** |
| lit control — 「no page was ever withheld」 in the first file | **true** |
| dark control — 「zzznotasentence」 in the first file | **false** |
| PR #17076 | still `open`, `merged: false`, `mergeable_state: blocked` |

⭐ **The honest part.** This seat's first probe was a single-line `git grep`, and it returned **exit 1, 0 lines** for carrier 1 — which would have read as 「already repaired, close the card」. It is a **false zero**: the sentence wraps, 「the serving door filters on」 ends one line and 「`status` / `type` and」 begins the next. The readings above are from a whitespace-normalised whole-file probe.

⚠️ ⛔ This is the **second** time today the same line-wrap produced a false zero for this seat, and **this very card's body warns about it in as many words**. The warning was written and then not applied. Recorded here so the next reader distrusts a line-wise zero on this sentence specifically, ⛔ rather than trusting that the warning is enough.
